title: Canonical constant-coefficient derived projection morphism
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme with small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring. Use $D(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $D(\Lambda)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. The constant-presheaf functor to presheaves of $\Lambda$-modules has the uniquely determined monoidal core whose unit and tensor constraints have identity components at every site object. Its composite with monoidal sheafification is the constant-sheaf functor $a^*$ of [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. It preserves flat objects. Let $L=La^*$, canonically identified with the termwise constant-complex functor since $a^*$ is exact, and let $R=R\Gamma(X_{\Et},-)$ be the unbounded right derived functor of [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor]. Use the canonical derived adjunction $L\dashv R$ induced from constant sheaves and global sections, with counit $\varepsilon$. The canonical comparison $c_{M,N}:L(M\otimes^L_\Lambda N)\longrightarrow LM\otimes^L_\Lambda LN$ is obtained by deriving the normalized ordinary constant-sheaf comonoidal constraint; on K-flat representatives it is the ordinary tensor comparison followed by the localization identifications. For arbitrary $E\in D(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and $K\in D(\Lambda)$ define the constant-coefficient projection morphism to be the adjunct of $c_{RE,K}$ followed by $\varepsilon_E\otimes 1_{LK}$:
$$\mathrm{PF}_{X,\Lambda}(E,K): RE\otimes^L_\Lambda K\longrightarrow R(E\otimes^L_\Lambda LK).$$
No finite dimension, torsion, boundedness, properness or invertibility assumption enters this construction.
